summary: The open model ecosystem is anchored by Hugging Face, which crossed 3 million public models in August 2026 and serves as the central hub for distribution, while download data shows extreme concentration—roughly half of all models have under 200 downloads and the top 200 account for nearly half of all downloads. Alongside the repository, a layer of developer-facing inference platforms (Ollama, Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, SiliconFlow and others) provides hosted or local APIs for running open-weight models, increasingly dominated by high-parameter Chinese releases from labs like Moonshot, MiniMax, Xiaomi and Z.ai. These are distinct from enterprise aggregators (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) and MLOps platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI).

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central open repository and community hub for hosting, sharing, versioning, and distributing AI models, datasets, and demo apps (Spaces), with an optional Inference API/Endpoints layer.
platforms.model_count: ~3 million+ public models (crossed 3,011,630 in August 2026, adding ~747,000 in the first 7.7 months of 2026)
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public hosting and community use; PRO subscription (~$9/mo); pay-as-you-go Inference Endpoints (per-hour compute, GPU-dependent); Enterprise Hub plans billed per seat
features: Largest open model and dataset registry with Git-based version control
Transformers, Diffusers, and Datasets libraries integration
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Spaces for hosting interactive demos (Gradio/Streamlit)
Download statistics using de-duplicated query-file counting
Model cards, safetensors, and community collaboration tools
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and developers who need the broadest selection of open models/datasets and tooling for sharing and fine-tuning

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: Local-first runtime for downloading and running open-weight LLMs on personal machines or servers with a simple CLI and local API.
platforms.model_count: ~200+ curated models in its library (plus any GGUF model importable from Hugging Face)
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; runs on local hardware so cost is your own compute; optional Ollama cloud/turbo tiers for hosted inference
features: One-command model pulls and local serving
OpenAI-compatible local REST API
Quantized GGUF models for consumer GPUs/CPUs
Modelfile system for custom model configs and system prompts
Cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows)
Works offline for privacy-sensitive use
platforms.best_for: Developers and hobbyists who want private, offline, local inference without cloud dependencies

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: Cloud platform for running and deploying open-source models (LLMs, image, video, audio) via API without managing infrastructure, using containerized Cog packaging.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community-published models and fine-tunes
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use, billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU pricing) or per-output for some models; no idle cost on scale-to-zero
features: Run any public model via a simple HTTP API
Cog framework for packaging and deploying custom models
Strong catalog of image/video/audio generation models
Automatic scaling and scale-to-zero
Fine-tuning support for select models
Webhooks and streaming outputs
platforms.best_for: App developers who want to integrate diverse generative models via API with minimal ops overhead

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: High-performance inference and fine-tuning cloud for open-weight LLMs and multimodal models, plus GPU clusters for training.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, and other leading open releases)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for inference (varies by model size); hourly GPU cluster rental for training; dedicated endpoint options
features: Fast serverless inference with OpenAI-compatible API
Fine-tuning and LoRA training services
Dedicated endpoints and GPU clusters (including H100/H200)
Support for large frontier open models
Batch inference and JSON mode
Competitive token pricing for high throughput
platforms.best_for: Startups and teams building production LLM apps that need scalable, low-cost open-model inference and fine-tuning

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: Speed-optimized inference platform for open-weight LLMs and multimodal models, focused on low latency and high throughput for production workloads.
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token (input/output), with per-GPU-second pricing for dedicated deployments and fine-tuning
features: Highly optimized serving stack (FireAttention) for low latency
OpenAI-compatible API
Fine-tuning and LoRA serving at scale
Function calling and structured JSON output
Dedicated and on-demand deployments
Support for vision and audio models
platforms.best_for: Production teams prioritizing inference speed, latency, and throughput for open models at scale

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: Developer inference platform offering a broad catalog of open-weight models (especially strong on Chinese open models like Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi/Moonshot) via a unified API.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models including leading Chinese releases
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token pricing with competitive rates; free credits/tier for new users; some models offered free or at very low cost
features: OpenAI-compatible API access
Strong coverage of top Chinese open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi)
Text, image, audio, and video model support
Fast serverless inference
Fine-tuning and dedicated instances
Reflects China's rising lead in high-parameter open models
platforms.best_for: Developers (especially in APAC) wanting cost-effective access to leading Chinese and global open models

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: Unified API router/aggregator that provides a single endpoint to access hundreds of open and proprietary models across many underlying providers with automatic routing and fallback.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models (open and closed) from dozens of providers
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token passthrough pricing with provider-based rates; small platform fee; some free models available
features: Single OpenAI-compatible endpoint for many providers
Automatic provider routing, load balancing, and fallback
Price and latency comparison across providers
Access to both open-weight and frontier closed models
Unified billing and usage analytics
platforms.best_for: Developers who want provider-agnostic access and automatic failover across many models through one API

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: Ultra-low-latency inference platform running open-weight LLMs on custom LPU hardware for extremely fast token generation.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of curated open models (Llama, Qwen, Mixtral, Gemma, and others)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token with very competitive rates; free developer tier with rate limits
features: LPU-based hardware delivering industry-leading tokens/sec
OpenAI-compatible API
Extremely low latency for real-time applications
Curated selection of popular open models
Batch and streaming support
platforms.best_for: Developers building latency-critical, real-time applications on open models
